races.paceDynamic: Dashing Donkey will take the field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, likely joined by prominent runners Devious Devan and The Ubermensch in the early stages. With only one natural leader, the pace should be manageable rather than suicidal, allowing Dashing Donkey to dictate terms without excessive pressure. The large field of hold-up horses will be relying on the pace to set up properly, but with limited early speed this may not develop into the strong gallop they need. This race shape clearly favours the early-positioned horses who can secure good positions without having to fight for them.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Dashing Donkey gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate a steady tempo and kick clear when ready, while the hold-up brigade struggles to pick up the pieces from a modest pace. Early pace horses like The Ubermensch and even Devious Devan can track the leader without being softened up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustainable Strong Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Devious Devan and The Ubermensch press Dashing Donkey early to ensure a proper gallop
scenarios.body: The genuine pace will set up perfectly for the better hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks in the final furlong. Quality closers like The Spotlight Kid and Moonlight Bomb will have the race run to suit their patterns.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If all the early runners are overly cautious and nobody wants to commit to making the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole with positioning crucial as horses fan wide looking for racing room. Those drawn well or ridden positively will have significant advantages over those caught behind horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Duel Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If Devious Devan's known tendency to fade combines with The Ubermensch over-racing to pressure Dashing Donkey
scenarios.body: The early pace will collapse entering the final 2f, allowing a strong closer who avoided the early skirmishing to sweep through and win going away. This suits the patient hold-up horses with the best turn of foot.

watchPoints.text: Devious Devan's tendency to fade in the finish could leave Dashing Donkey unopposed if The Ubermensch doesn't press
The massive field of hold-up horses will struggle for racing room if the pace is too steady early
Miss Monte Carlo's 540-day absence makes her impossible to assess but creates potential eliminator for multiples
Several runners returning from lengthy breaks including Le Pelerin (156d) and Queen Of Good News (176d) face fitness questions
Watch for Dashing Donkey's early fractions - if uncontested the leader will be very hard to peg back

races.paceDynamic: Ottoman Empress will take this field along at a steady gallop with minimal early pressure, given the lack of other committed front-runners in this fillies' novice field. Harper Violet and Harriet Quimby may track her in second and third, but neither appears keen to force the issue early. The pace will be genuine but not frantic, allowing the field to stay in touch through the first mile before the real test begins in the final two furlongs. This controlled tempo strongly favours prominent racers who can stay close to Ottoman Empress and hold-up horses with finishing kicks over the extended straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front End
scenarios.trigger: If Ottoman Empress dictates uncontested fractions and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets first run turning for home and proves tough to peg back up the Yarmouth straight. Her class edge and tactical advantage prove decisive against these lightly-raced rivals.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the steady early pace sets up a sprint finish over the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their perfect scenario as the race becomes a dash from the back. Fresh legs and finishing speed trump early position in a bunched finale.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Harper Violet or Harriet Quimby apply early pressure to Ottoman Empress
scenarios.body: The pace quickens beyond comfort levels for the front-runner, opening the door for those tracking in fourth and fifth. Mid-race positioning becomes crucial as the early leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Ottoman Empress goes too slowly and gets swamped late
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a messy sprint where any horse can win from anywhere. Form and class become secondary to luck in running and jockey judgment.

races.paceDynamic: Desert Heart, Shihoku, Something, and Mc'ted will set a genuine gallop from the start, with Desert Heart likely to take them along early before the others engage. This strong pace will stretch the field over the extended 1m2f trip, creating a searching test of stamina on Good ground. The early gallop will soften up the leaders and set up the race perfectly for hold-up horses who can stay the trip and finish strongly. This race shape strongly favours patient, staying types who race from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners maintain a strong gallop throughout the early and middle stages.
scenarios.body: The pace will collapse in the final two furlongs, allowing the patient closers with stamina to sweep past tired leaders. Horses like Salamanca City, Silver Gunn, and A Major Payne are perfectly positioned to capitalize on this likely scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Desert Heart and the other leaders go too fast early and burn out before halfway.
scenarios.body: The race will become a sprint finish with prominent racers taking over, but the genuine stayers still hold the advantage. Siouxfonic and Yaa Min can bridge the gap between pace and closers in this situation.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Something or Shihoku prove tougher than expected and maintain the gallop to the line.
scenarios.body: The leaders will take some catching if they can sustain their effort over this stamina-sapping trip. Only the very best stayers with tactical speed will get there in time.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners are more cautious than expected and the early pace becomes moderate.
scenarios.body: The race becomes more about tactical positioning and a turn of foot, suiting horses who can quicken from prominent positions. This would be the least likely outcome given the number of confirmed pace-setters.

This setup strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems that will inevitably plague the large group of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Master Of Keraunos maintains his rhythm without serious challenge until the final furlong
scenarios.body: He gets soft fractions and kicks clear when the field starts their run, holding off late challengers who struggle to make up the ground. The tactical advantage of racing alone up front proves decisive over a straight course.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If My Mate Roger or Al Maslool can position perfectly behind Master Of Keraunos and time their challenge
scenarios.body: They get first run on the leader while the hold-up horses are still finding racing room in behind. The combination of good position and tactical nous from experienced connections pays dividends.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Hold-Up Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Generic or Enemy Agent can secure a clear passage and unleash superior finishing speed
scenarios.body: The higher-rated hold-up horses overcome tactical disadvantage through sheer ability, with Oisin Murphy's positioning skills or Enemy Agent's proven turn of foot proving crucial. Traffic problems still make their task difficult.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the newcomers like Sierra Sue or Whole Lotta Rosie possesses hidden ability and gets the right trip
scenarios.body: Unknown potential combines with a good draw or tactical ride to spring an upset. However, the lack of experience against seasoned opponents makes this outcome unlikely.
